messages.content: Hi, it's your weekly check-in from Northline Care. How are things going this week — any readings to log or anything on your mind?
Honestly not great. My insurance denied my test strip claim and I'm basically out now. Haven't been able to check my blood sugar in a couple days.

I'm really sorry you're dealing with that — it's a frustrating situation. I have to be upfront with you: insurance claims and appeals are outside what I'm able to help with. That'll need to go through your insurer directly, or your pharmacy's billing desk can sometimes point you to next steps. Do you have a reading from before you ran out that I can log for you?
Yeah the last one I got was 162 Thursday morning, fasting. I feel okay, no dizziness or anything, just stressed about not being able to keep track.

Got it — logging 162 mg/dL fasting from Thursday. Good that you're not having any symptoms. I'll set your next check-in for next week, and if anything changes before then — a weird reading once you get more strips, or any new symptoms — just text back.
Okay, will do. I'll give the pharmacy a call tomorrow.

theme: insurance denied test strips or a claim question
